title: The Extract of Ilex cornuta Bark Promotes Bone Healing by Activating Adenosine A2A Receptor.
authors: Zheng, Xi; Wang, Jingyi; Zhou, Junlin; Wang, Dong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究冬青树皮提取物促进骨愈合，涉及ADORA2A与转录因子NFKB1的分子对接，但核心是药物作用机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Bone fracture is a common reason causing human disability. The delay union and nonunion rates are approximately 5-10% despite patients receiving active treatment. Currently, there is a limited number of drugs directly accelerating bone healing, especially direct extracts from plants. Moreover, the pharmacological effects of Ilex cornuta bark are still unknown. This study aimed to explore the effects and mechanisms of Ilex cornuta bark in bone healing. METHODS AND RESULTS: First, the promoting effects of Ilex cornuta bark on bone healing were verified by the mice femur fracture model as Ilex cornuta bark increased the callus formation and enhanced the biomechanical stability during the bone healing process. Second, the target gene of Ilex cornuta bark in bone healing identified by bioinformatics analysis and immunofluorescence validation was ADORA2A. Third, 410 main compound compositions of Ilex cornuta bark were explored by a non-target metabolomic analysis, where 190 of them were neg ion mode, and 220 were pos ion mode. Molecular docking was used to predict the regulatory effect of the compounds on adora2a (adenosine A2A receptor), and ursonic acid had the lowest binding energy with adora2a. Finally, nfkb1 was the transcription factor (TF) of adora2a, and ursonic acid also had the lowest binding energy by bioinformatic analysis and molecular docking. CONCLUSION: Overall, Ilex cornuta bark water extract was a new plant extract on promoting bone healing; in addition, the mechanism of it might be activating adora2a though Nfkb1.
abstract_zh: 引言：骨折是导致人类残疾的常见原因。尽管患者接受积极治疗，延迟愈合和不愈合率约为5-10%。目前，直接加速骨愈合的药物数量有限，尤其是植物直接提取物。此外，枸骨冬青（Ilex cornuta）树皮的药理作用仍未知。本研究旨在探讨枸骨冬青树皮在骨愈合中的作用及机制。方法与结果：首先，通过小鼠股骨骨折模型验证了枸骨冬青树皮对骨愈合的促进作用，因为枸骨冬青树皮增加了骨痂形成，并增强了骨愈合过程中的生物力学稳定性。其次，通过生物信息学分析和免疫荧光验证，确定枸骨冬青树皮在骨愈合中的靶基因为ADORA2A。第三，通过非靶向代谢组学分析探索了枸骨冬青树皮的410种主要化合物组成，其中190种为负离子模式，220种为正离子模式。使用分子对接（molecular docking）预测化合物对adora2a（腺苷A2A受体）的调控作用，熊果酸与adora2a的结合能最低。最后，nfkb1是adora2a的转录因子（transcription factor, TF），通过生物信息学分析和分子对接，熊果酸也具有最低结合能。结论：总体而言，枸骨冬青树皮水提取物是一种促进骨愈合的新型植物提取物；此外，其机制可能通过Nfkb1激活adora2a。
